patch_instances_contextmanager: use the patch_instances context manager to replace detectron2 Instances with a scriptable TorchScript-compatible class
gen_instance_class_code_gen: generate a TorchScript-compatible Instances class definition from a dictionary of field names and types
patch_builtin_len_contextmanager: use the patch_builtin_len context manager to replace builtin len calls with __len__ for TorchScript tracing compatibility
patch_nonscriptable_classes: apply patches to make ResNet, FPN, and StandardROIHeads classes compatible with TorchScript compilation
freeze_training_mode_contextmanager: use the freeze_training_mode context manager to annotate training attributes as constants so TorchScript can optimize away training codepaths
